title: Sample trend: Multiple small signals are starting to point in one direction
summary: Demo ng Trend Engine. Hindi sapat ang isang headline; kailangan ng repeated independent observations at evidence against.
why_it_matters: The value of the Trend page is continuity—makikita kung lumalakas, humihina o nagre-reverse ang signal over time.

content.connection: The observations may reflect a common policy direction, but this remains a hypothesis.
content.alternative_explanation: They may be unrelated administrative changes rather than one coordinated trend.
content.watch_next: Formal rulemaking, budget allocation or implementation guidance.
content.implications: If confirmed, the practical impact would depend on the final scope.

title: Sample: Mali tayo — the earlier prediction did not happen
summary: The app should keep failed predictions visible. This demo shows how the system can explain what went wrong instead of quietly deleting the old call.
why_it_matters: Prediction tracking is only useful if wrong calls are preserved and analyzed.

content.statement: Sample earlier forecast that X would happen within the target window.
content.alternative_explanation: The system over-weighted announcement momentum and under-weighted execution barriers.
content.implications: Future forecasts should reduce weight on announcements without operational evidence.
